integrity.computational_artifact: Exact rational checks for one representative chain only; finite checks do not establish the general theorem.
integrity.proof_type: analytical birth-death scale-product and Doob h-transform argument

scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the first-moment boundary beta=1.
The drift error must be o(1/(x (log x)^2)); the weaker o(1/(x log x)) condition is not settled here.
The chain must be irreducible, nearest-neighbour, and move from zero to one; no claim is made for general bounded jumps.
title: The critical strong-transience boundary for a nearest-neighbour birth–death chain
